summary.text: Danny Crawford, a Republican, has represented District 5 in the Alabama House of Representatives since taking office on February 17, 2016, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.

paragraphs.text: Crawford received a B.A. and an M.A. from Auburn University, and his professional experience includes serving as state director of the Farm Service Agency and working as a crop insurance contractor.
He served on the Athens City Council from 1993 to 2005.
